name: Xero MCP
description: Connects agents to Xero accounting through Xero's hosted remote MCP server or a local npm server to list and create invoices, contacts, payments, and journals, and pull financial reports.

skills.name: Invoice Management
skills.description: Lists, creates, and updates draft invoices, quotes, and credit notes in a Xero organisation through MCP commands.

skills.name: Contact Management
skills.description: Lists, creates, and updates Xero contacts and contact groups, and pulls aged receivables and payables per contact.

skills.name: Financial Reports
skills.description: Retrieves profit and loss, balance sheet, and trial balance reports from Xero for the connected organisation.

skills.name: Payroll Timesheets
skills.description: Lists payroll employees and leave, and creates, updates, approves, or reverts payroll timesheets for NZ and UK orgs.

skills.name: Bank Transactions
skills.description: Lists, creates, and updates bank transactions and payments, and records manual journals in a Xero organisation.
